notes:
Account summary: product org (mobile + web) building an in-app AI assistant for workflow suggestions + code snippets for power users. Started with Hosted API trial in Jan 2026; trial data used to forecast Dedicated needs. Team pragmatic about cost but unwilling to compromise sub-200ms interactive latency for chat flows.

Key contacts: CTO - Maya Lin (technical), Head of Product - Aaron Cho (PM sponsor). AE/owner Jordan Blake. SE Priya Kapoor leading POC; CSM Evan Ruiz lined up post-purchase.

Hosted trial highlights (observed metrics): average daily active users in trial cohort: 1,200; average requests/day (app hooks) ~28k; average tokens per request (prompt+completion) ~420; token mix: ~65% short chat queries (30-200 tokens), ~25% medium conversational flows (200-800 tokens), ~10% long summarization/condense jobs (1k-3k tokens). Mean RT (hosted) for prompt->first-token: 210ms (p95 420ms) using open-llama-13B-optim variant. Embeddings usage (doc-search) small but growing: ~6k embeddings/day.

Traffic shape & patterns: weekday business hours (09:00-15:00 PT) show pronounced peaks; typical burst multiplier x3 from baseline; concurrency during peak windows observed at ~28-35 concurrent generation sessions in the trial sample. Night/weekend tail negligible.

Pricing/POC conversations so far: discussed 3-tier dedicated options (2-GPU, 4-GPU, 8-GPU) with reserved throughput and burst credits. Customer prefers predictable monthly commit; wants a pricing comparison showing break-even point vs hosted at 9-12 months. They asked for examples of autoscale behavior and how fallback to hosted works during capacity spikes.

Security/compliance: requires SSO + audit logs. Data residency: primary requirement to keep user PII in NA region only. Legal requested sample SOC2 artifact and encryption-at-rest/KMS details (ticket RN-3241).

Customer quotes (from product demo): "We need the assistant to feel instantaneous — anything >250ms loses the rhythm of the user." — Aaron Cho. "Budget is realistic but we need deterministic unit costs to include in our pricing model." — Maya Lin.

POC checklist status: Hosted trial completed (logs ingested), initial eval dashboard shared, SE-led traffic analysis completed, dedicated pricing draft v2 sent 2026-03-04, legal routing started 2026-03-08.

Next tacticals: send capacity calc workbook, schedule 60m infra workshop, provide SOW redline for residency clause, deliver explicit runbook for burst handling and fallback policy.
